newsitem.title: USA: EcoTyre says will remain on NASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: EcoTyre says will remain on NASDAQ.

text.p: EcoTyre Technologies Inc said Friday its common stock and warrants will continue to be listed on the Nasdaq smallcap market through an exception from the minimum bid price requirement.
The company said it was granted a temporary exception from this standard as long as it meets certain conditions. The exception will expire on June 2, 1997.
The company said that if its securities should cease to be listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market, they may continue to be listed on the OTC-Bulletin Board.
For the duration of the exception, the Company's Nasdaq symbols will be ETTIC and ETTIWC.
